flavor.1: {attacker} puts the whole weight of the body into the blow - {target} is thrown backwards!
flavor.2: {attacker} cuts through the defence like wet paper - {target} has no time to cover up!
flavor.3: {attacker} strikes with a crack like thunder over Ashan - {target} reels in pain!

2.name: Maximum damage
2.description: Damage = the maximum value of the dice

flavor.1: A perfect strike! {attacker} finds the weakest spot - {target} feels it.
flavor.2: {attacker} is fortune's favourite: every die shows its maximum.
flavor.3: {attacker} strikes with a master's cold precision - {target} has nothing to soften the blow.

flavor.1: {attacker} feels the rhythm of battle - the next strike will land even better.
flavor.2: {attacker}'s eyes flare: every enemy move is now an open book. Target: {target}.
flavor.3: Blood boils, the hand is steady - {attacker} is already preparing the next strike.

4.name: Weakened defence
4.description: The target gets -2 AC until the start of its next turn

flavor.1: {attacker} splits the armour - {target} feels a gap opening in the plate!
flavor.2: {target} cannot hold the shield: the straps snap and it sags on the arm.
flavor.3: {attacker} strikes - {target} loses balance and the defence falls apart.

flavor.1: {attacker} twists the blade in the wound - {target} screams in pain!
flavor.2: {attacker} adds an elbow to the blow - sneaky, but effective.
flavor.3: {target} feels a second wave of pain: {attacker} catches the bone.

flavor.1: {target} has no time to cover up: {attacker} strikes again!
flavor.2: {attacker} moves faster than thought - another attack is ready!
flavor.3: A whirlwind of steel: {attacker} immediately strikes again.

7.name: Bonus action blocked
7.description: The enemy loses its Bonus Action next turn

flavor.1: Stunned: {attacker} strikes so hard that there is no room for tricks next turn. Target: {target}.
flavor.2: {target} clutches the wound and forgets everything but it.
flavor.3: {target} hears only ringing in the ears - small manoeuvres will have to wait.

8.name: Ignore reactions
8.description: The attack ignores the target's reactions

flavor.1: {attacker} strikes so suddenly that {target} cannot even swing back.
flavor.2: A blow from the blind spot - {target} does not see where death came from.
flavor.3: {attacker} slips under the guard - {target} has no chance to retaliate.

9.name: Mark for Advantage
9.description: The next attack against the target has Advantage

flavor.1: {target} is left open after the blow - {attacker} and allies see the weak spot!
flavor.2: {target} is bleeding - such a wound is easy to hit again.
flavor.3: {attacker} marks the target: now {target} is easy prey.

flavor.1: {attacker} does not stop - a spin and another desperate strike!
flavor.2: Combo! {attacker} keeps attacking, even while losing balance.
flavor.3: {attacker} cannot stop - momentum carries on: another strike, crude but dangerous.

1.name: Simple miss
1.description: A miss with no additional effects

flavor.1: {attacker} slices through the void - {target} does not even flinch.
flavor.2: {attacker} strikes aside. It happens.
flavor.3: {attacker} misses so badly that it is embarrassing in front of the comrades.

flavor.1: {attacker} slips on the bloody ground and lands in the mud!
flavor.2: The foot twists - and {attacker} is already on the ground, staring at the sky.
flavor.3: The swing is too wide: {attacker} falls, losing balance.

flavor.1: Dust in the eyes - {attacker} strikes blindly with the next blow.
flavor.2: After the failed swing the hand trembles - {attacker} loses confidence.
flavor.3: {attacker} can barely see: sweat floods the eyes and the target blurs.

4.name: Bonus action lost
4.description: Loses the Bonus Action this turn

flavor.1: {attacker} frantically fixes the grip - there is no time left for small things.
flavor.2: A strap tangles - {attacker} loses a precious moment.
flavor.3: Confusion after the miss - {attacker} forgets the plan.

5.name: Weapon slips
5.description: The next hit deals x0.5 damage

flavor.1: The hilt slips from a sweaty palm: {attacker} strikes weakly with the next blow.
flavor.2: {attacker} almost drops the weapon, and now the grip is clumsy.
flavor.3: {attacker} strikes the rocks - the blade goes dull.

6.name: Weakened defence
6.description: -2 AC until the start of the next turn

flavor.1: {attacker} overextends after the swing - the defence is useless.
flavor.2: The buckle snaps, the armour slides aside - {attacker} is left unprotected.
flavor.3: {attacker} turns their back to the enemies: the momentum of the swing does its work.

flavor.1: {attacker} stumbles and opens up for a strike. Nearby: {target}.
flavor.2: A failed lunge - {attacker} is left without cover. Nearby: {target}.
flavor.3: {attacker} makes a mistake, and {target} notices: the guard is open.

8.name: Reaction lost
8.description: Loses the reaction until the next turn

flavor.1: After the miss {attacker} has no time to answer a blow.
flavor.2: {attacker} loses focus: the enemy can strike without fear of retaliation.
flavor.3: {attacker} is too absorbed in their own mistake to watch the enemy.

9.name: Mark for the enemy
9.description: The next attack against the character has Advantage

flavor.1: {attacker} overextends - now every enemy sees the weak spot.
flavor.2: {attacker} is left unprotected after the miss, and the enemies notice.
flavor.3: {attacker} stands like a target in the middle of the battlefield.

flavor.1: The failed strike is exhausting - {attacker} recovers next turn.
flavor.2: The weapon gets stuck - {attacker} pries it out next turn.
flavor.3: {attacker} loses bearings: the head spins, and next turn the fighter is of little use.

1.name: Full evasion
1.description: Spell damage = 0, even on a 'half' save

flavor.1: {target} dives under the wave of magic - {attacker}'s spell does not leave a scratch.
flavor.2: {target} slips out from under the blow so easily, as if {attacker} aimed at a shadow.

flavor.1: {target} catches the rhythm of {attacker}'s spell - the next strike will land better.
flavor.2: {attacker}'s magic slides past, and {target} already spots the enemy's weak point.

flavor.1: {target} dispels {attacker}'s spell and is already preparing a counterattack before the caster recovers!
flavor.2: {attacker}'s spell crumbles into sparks - {target} gathers strength for a counterattack.

4.name: Hardening
4.description: +2 AC until the start of the next turn

flavor.1: {attacker}'s magic hardens {target}: the skin turns hard as stone.
flavor.2: {target} deflects {attacker}'s spell and feels an invisible shield cover the silhouette.

flavor.1: {target} shakes off {attacker}'s spell like raindrops - no affliction sticks.
flavor.2: {target}'s mind is clear as a spring: {attacker}'s casting dissolves without a trace.

flavor.1: {target} survived {attacker}'s spell and feels an unexpected surge of strength.
flavor.2: The blow of {attacker}'s magic only quickens {target}'s blood - time seems to slow down.

1.name: Double damage
1.description: Spell damage is doubled for this target

flavor.1: {target} steps right into the point of {attacker}'s spell - the pain is double!
flavor.2: {attacker}'s magic hits {target} with doubled force.

flavor.1: The wave of {attacker}'s spell knocks {target} off their feet.
flavor.2: {target} loses balance under the onslaught of {attacker}'s magic and falls flat.

flavor.1: {attacker}'s spell clouds {target}'s sight - the next strike will go blind.
flavor.2: {target} is bewildered by {attacker}'s magic: the hand trembles, the target swims before the eyes.

4.name: Gap in the defence
4.description: -2 AC until the start of the next turn

flavor.1: {attacker}'s magic shakes {target}'s defence - a gap appears in the armour.
flavor.2: {target} is left open under {attacker}'s spell: the defence barely holds.

5.name: Reaction lost
5.description: Loses the reaction until the next turn

flavor.1: {target} freezes under {attacker}'s spell and has no time to react.
flavor.2: {attacker}'s magic stuns {target} - there will be no answering the blow.

6.name: Bonus action lost
6.description: The target loses its Bonus Action next turn

flavor.1: {attacker}'s spell drains {target} - no strength is left for small manoeuvres.
flavor.2: {target} clutches the head: {attacker}'s spell wiped every trick from memory.
